findings.title: Field type changed without relayout; error ignored
findings.message: syncFieldOutline silently returns on a style resolution error and otherwise overwrites field.Type on every sync, overriding any type the backend set elsewhere. It also sets Type without triggering a restyle/relayout, so a border change on a retained field may not take effect until the next layout.
findings.suggestion: Only update when Type changes and call field.NeedsLayout()/Update; propagate the error rather than swallowing it.

finding.title: Same widget IDs rendered from shared state in multiple views
finding.message: The gallery view() is called twice per render in the normal gallery: once for the Input helpers tab via g.inputHelpers.view() and again in tests; the search/notice descriptors are re-created each call, which is fine, but the Tabs child ID "inputs" and the "about" ID are unique only if view succeeds. On the error path the node is a Label named "inputs", which is acceptable. However m.search.Style is mutated by setAppearance on the shared instance when -mac-widgets is set, after g.view was created; low risk.
finding.suggestion: Verify no duplicate IDs occur when both g.view and inputHelpers.view render the same IDs in one window.
